name: insane-review-codex
description: 관련 코드를 repomix로 패킹하고 Codex Desktop 내장 Browser/IAB로 구독 ChatGPT Pro 리뷰를 회수한다. 실제 모델/Pro 확인, 대화 URL과 신규 턴 결속, 중단 후 재전송 방지. CLI와 agent-council은 기존 CDP 경로 유지.

interface.shortDescription: Send code to GPT Pro (subscription web, latest flagship) and get a review back — inside Codex
interface.longDescription: Packs relevant code with repomix and uses Codex Desktop Browser/IAB tools to attach it to ChatGPT Pro and retrieve the review. Local manifests track preparation, sending, conversation binding and completion. Existing CDP automation remains available for CLI and agent-council.
defaultPrompt: Use insane-review to get a GPT Pro opinion on this code.
Review this module with GPT Pro and tell me what it thinks.
Pack the src/ directory and send it to ChatGPT Pro for a design review.
